introduction: This spec adds `speca`, the read-only spec admin command, which reports a package's lifecycle and task state, gives the format's full verdict on a package, and lists every package under the spec root. It adds readiness and next-task rules to `afspec`, a shared `internal/specpkg` package used by `specr`, `speca` and `specgen`, and the public `AdminResult` output type in `envelope`.

glossary.cross-spec rules: The rules of afspec.ValidateCrossSpec (format v2 §10.4): unknown dependency, dependency cycle, actor, and glossary conflict.
glossary.display rule: A package path is shown relative to --dir when it lies inside it, and absolute otherwise.
glossary.form: One operation of speca: the report (speca <spec>), the verdict (--validate), or the list (--list).
glossary.intent drift: An active package with an intent_hash whose PRD body no longer hashes to that value, or no longer has a ## Intent section.
glossary.next task: The first in_progress task in plan order, otherwise the first ready task, as returned by (*TasksV2Json).NextTask.
glossary.package reference: The single positional input of specr and speca: a path to a package directory or a file in it, or a directory name, number or name under the spec root.
glossary.program-driven path: Any invocation other than -h/--help, --version and a bare invocation on a terminal; each writes exactly one JSON envelope to stdout.
glossary.ready task: A pending task whose dependencies are all done; dependencies come from depends_on when present, otherwise the previous task in plan order (format v2 §8.3).
glossary.rule name: The Check of a validation entry, or its Category when Check is empty.
glossary.spec root: The directory holding the NN_name spec packages, resolved by afspec.ResolveSpecsDir from --specs-dir and --dir (default .specs).

requirements.title: Readiness and the next task in afspec
requirements.rationale: "Ready" and "next" must mean the same thing in every command and follow format v2 §8.3, not the example's shortcut.

criteria.action: return true exactly when the task with the given id exists, its state is pending, and every one of its dependencies is done, where the dependencies are its depends_on list when the field is present (an explicitly empty list meaning none) and otherwise the task immediately before it in plan order (none for the first task)
criteria.contract: IsReady(id int) bool

criteria.condition: a dependency id is not in the plan, or the dependency's state is dropped
criteria.action: treat that dependency as not done
criteria.contract: IsReady returns false for the dependent task

criteria.condition: the task id is not in the plan or the receiver is nil
criteria.action: report the task as not ready without panicking
criteria.contract: IsReady returns false

criteria.condition: NextTask is called on a plan that has at least one in_progress task
criteria.action: return a copy of the first in_progress task in plan order, so that mutating the copy leaves the plan unchanged
criteria.contract: (*Task, true)

criteria.condition: NextTask is called on a plan that has no in_progress task
criteria.action: return a copy of the first task in plan order for which IsReady is true
criteria.contract: (*Task, true) when such a task exists

criteria.condition: the receiver is nil, the plan is empty, or the plan has neither an in_progress task nor a ready task
criteria.action: return no task without panicking
criteria.contract: (nil, false)

criteria.condition: examples/tasks pick is called with id 0
criteria.action: select the task with NextTask, and when there is none, fail with "every task is done or dropped" if every task is done or dropped and with "no pending task has all its dependencies done" otherwise
criteria.contract: the existing examples/tasks tests pass unchanged

criteria.action: for any task plan, when NextTask returns (t, true), t is the first in_progress task in plan order, or, when no task is in progress, IsReady(t.Id) is true and no earlier task in plan order is ready

requirements.title: Shared internal/specpkg package
requirements.rationale: specr, speca and specgen need one copy of the resolver, task summary and report converters instead of three.

criteria.action: resolve a package reference first as a path to a package directory or a file in it (relative to the working directory, then to --dir), then as a directory name, number or name under the spec root, reaching an archived package only by its path, with the same results specr's former locate gave
criteria.contract: the absolute package directory, or an error

criteria.condition: the reference is -, a URL, or multi-line, or it names no package or more than one
criteria.action: refuse the reference with a usage error whose message names the caller-supplied tool, and when no live package matches but an archived one does, name that archived package in the message
criteria.contract: *cli.UsageError with Category() "usage"; the message begins with the tool name passed in (specr or speca)

criteria.action: list the NN_name directories under a root and format a package path by the display rule (relative to --dir when inside it, absolute otherwise)
produce one envelope.TaskInfo per task in plan order carrying id, title, kind, state, optional, a copy of depends_on, and ready set from IsReady
criteria.contract: []envelope.TaskInfo

criteria.action: convert an afspec.ValidationResult into an envelope.ValidationReport and a spec's derived traceability into an envelope.TraceReport, and specgen uses these converters so that spec's result for the same package is byte-for-byte unchanged
return the rule names of a set of validation entries as the distinct Check of each entry (its Category when Check is empty) in order of first appearance

criteria.condition: specr resolves and renders a package
criteria.action: use the shared resolver, display rule and task summary, producing the same output as before except that each entry of result.tasks and result.task carries ready, and its regenerated schema golden file includes ready
criteria.contract: cmd/specr tests and the regenerated cmd/specr/testdata/schema.golden.json pass

requirements.title: The speca command and its interface
requirements.rationale: speca must follow the single-input, single-envelope interface of spec and specr so an agent can call it the same way.

criteria.action: accept speca [flags] <spec> and speca --list [--all], with the flags --validate, --list, --all, --specs-dir, --dir, --schema and --version given before or after the input, and write exactly one JSON envelope with tool "speca" to stdout on every program-driven path
criteria.contract: stdout decodes with envelope.DecodeSpeca; process exit code equals the envelope's exit_code

criteria.condition: speca is invoked with -h or --help
criteria.action: print help naming the forms and examples, with one line near the top saying that spec writes a package from an idea, specr renders one and speca reports its state, to stderr
criteria.contract: exit 0; stdout empty

criteria.condition: speca is invoked with no positional input and without --list
criteria.action: print the help to stderr and, when stdout is not a terminal, also write a usage envelope to stdout
criteria.contract: exit 2

criteria.condition: speca is invoked with --version
criteria.action: print speca followed by the build identity
criteria.contract: stdout is "speca <identity>"; exit 0

criteria.condition: speca is invoked with --schema
criteria.action: print a self-description holding tool, description (containing the sibling sentence), input with examples, flags from cli.FlagsDocument, result from cli.EnvelopeDocument without side_effects, input, model and usage, and exit_codes, without reading any package or directory
criteria.contract: exit 0; stdout equals cmd/speca/testdata/schema.golden.json, which UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 regenerates

criteria.condition: the invocation has more than one positional input, a positional input with --list, --validate with --list, --all without --list, an input that is -, a URL or multi-line, a --dir that is not a directory, a reference naming no package or two, or an undefined flag
criteria.action: refuse the call before reading any package, print the message to stderr, and write a usage envelope
criteria.contract: exit 2; error.stage "usage", error.category "usage"; result absent

criteria.action: write no file, make no model or network call, and read no credential or model environment variable in any form
criteria.contract: the spec root's file tree and modification times are identical before and after any speca call

criteria.action: install ./cmd/speca with the same $(LDFLAGS) as ./cmd/spec and ./cmd/specr, and name all three commands in the build target's help line

requirements.title: The report: speca <spec>
requirements.rationale: An agent needs one call that tells it a package's status, validity and which task to work on.

criteria.condition: speca <spec> resolves and loads a package
criteria.action: return in result spec_dir by the display rule, spec_id, spec_name, title, status, created_at and updated_at, plus intent_hash when set and supersedes and tags when not empty
criteria.contract: exit 0; error absent

criteria.condition: speca <spec> reports a package
criteria.action: set valid from (*Spec).Validate and, when it is false, set failing_rules to the rule names of the errors
criteria.contract: result.valid always present; result.failing_rules present only when valid is false

criteria.condition: speca <spec> or speca <spec> --validate reports a package
criteria.action: set intent_drift to true when the package is active, has an intent_hash, and its PRD body either hashes to a different value with afspec.ComputeIntentHash or has no ## Intent section, and omit intent_drift otherwise

criteria.condition: speca <spec> reports a package
criteria.action: return tasks as every task in plan order in TaskInfo form (an empty list when the plan has no tasks) and task_counts with pending, in_progress, done, dropped and total, and next_task as the TaskInfo of the task NextTask returns, omitted when there is none

criteria.condition: speca <spec> reports a package
criteria.action: return allowed_status as each of draft, active, sealed, superseded and archived, in that order, for which afspec.ValidTransition(status, target) holds
criteria.contract: an empty list for a terminal status

criteria.condition: speca <spec> reports a package
criteria.action: return depends_on as the spec_ids in the package's own tasks.json dependencies in file order with duplicates removed (an empty list when none), and dependents as the spec_ids of other packages under the spec root whose dependencies name this package, found with afspec.DiscoverSpecs and afspec.BuildDependencyGraph, sorted with duplicates removed
for any loaded package, task_counts.total equals the length of tasks and equals the sum of pending, in_progress, done and dropped

requirements.title: Report and verdict edge cases
requirements.rationale: A partial answer with a warning is more useful to an agent than a failed call, except when the package itself cannot be read.

criteria.condition: the spec root is missing, not a directory, or unreadable during speca <spec>
criteria.action: omit dependents and raise a low specs_dir_unreadable warning naming the root, reporting every other field
criteria.contract: exit 0; warnings contains code specs_dir_unreadable, severity low, stage preflight

criteria.condition: afspec.BuildDependencyGraph reports a dangling dependency
criteria.action: use the partial graph it returned to compute dependents
criteria.contract: exit 0; dependents lists the packages the partial graph names

criteria.condition: afspec.LoadSpec refuses the resolved package in the report or the verdict form
criteria.action: fail the call with a message naming the package directory and the library's reason
criteria.contract: exit 1; error.stage "load", error.category "input"; result absent

criteria.condition: the package's PRD schema_version is neither absent nor 2, in the report or the verdict form
criteria.action: report whatever loaded and raise a high spec_invalid warning saying the package's tests and tasks are not read
criteria.contract: exit 0; warnings contains code spec_invalid, severity high

criteria.condition: a format version 2 package is invalid
criteria.action: raise no spec_invalid warning in the report or the verdict form, leaving the answer to valid, failing_rules and validation
criteria.contract: warnings contains no spec_invalid entry

requirements.title: The verdict: speca <spec> --validate
requirements.rationale: Only a call that loads every package under the root can apply the cross-spec rules, so the full verdict is its own form.

criteria.condition: speca <spec> --validate resolves and loads a package
criteria.action: return the identity fields of the report, intent_drift, valid, validation as an envelope.ValidationReport (valid, error_count, warning_count, and each error and warning with check, artifact, entity and message) and traceability as an envelope.TraceReport (criteria_covered, criteria_uncovered, paths_covered, paths_uncovered, tests_unowned), and omit tasks, task_counts, next_task, allowed_status, depends_on, dependents and failing_rules
criteria.contract: exit 0

criteria.condition: speca <spec> --validate runs
criteria.action: combine (*Spec).Validate with afspec.ValidateCrossSpec run over every package under the spec root that loads, plus the target package when it is not among them, and a dependency graph built from those packages

criteria.condition: afspec.ValidateCrossSpec returns findings
criteria.action: keep only the errors whose entity is the package's spec_id, the errors that name no entity when the package has at least one edge in the graph, and the warnings whose entity is a term defined in the package's own glossary
criteria.contract: validation lists exactly the kept cross-spec findings after the package's own findings

criteria.action: set result.valid and validation.valid to true exactly when no error was kept from either source, with error_count and warning_count equal to the numbers of errors and warnings listed
criteria.contract: result.valid == validation.valid == (validation.error_count == 0)

criteria.condition: the spec root cannot be read during --validate
criteria.action: skip the cross-spec rules, raise a low specs_dir_unreadable warning naming the root, and report the per-package verdict on its own
criteria.contract: exit 0; warnings contains specs_dir_unreadable with severity low

criteria.condition: a package under the spec root other than the target fails to load during --validate
criteria.action: leave that package out of the cross-spec rules and continue
criteria.contract: exit 0; error absent

criteria.condition: the target package is invalid
criteria.action: report the verdict as a successful call
criteria.contract: exit 0; result.valid false; error absent

requirements.title: The list: speca --list [--all]
requirements.rationale: An agent needs an overview of every package, including those that no longer load.

criteria.condition: speca --list runs on a readable spec root
criteria.action: list the NN_name directories under the root itself (not through DiscoverSpecs), sort them by numeric prefix compared as a number with ties broken by full name, and load each with LoadSpec
criteria.contract: exit 0; result.packages in that order (100_x after 99_x)

criteria.condition: a listed package loads
criteria.action: emit an entry with spec_dir, spec_id, spec_name, title, status, valid from Validate, task_counts, and next_task when NextTask returns one

criteria.condition: a listed package fails to load, including a missing or malformed prd.md
criteria.action: emit an entry holding only spec_dir and load_error with the library's message, and continue with the next package
criteria.contract: exit 0; the entry has no other fields

criteria.condition: --all is given with --list
criteria.action: append the package directories under <root>/archive/ in the same order, each marked archived: true regardless of its status
criteria.contract: a superseded package under archive/ appears with archived: true and status: superseded

criteria.condition: --all is given and <root>/archive/ does not exist
criteria.action: add no entries and raise no warning
criteria.contract: exit 0; warnings empty

criteria.condition: the spec root does not exist or cannot be read during --list
criteria.action: fail the call with a message naming the root
criteria.contract: exit 1; error.stage "load", error.category "input", error.fix_hint.flag "--specs-dir"

criteria.condition: speca --list runs on a spec root that exists and holds no package directories
criteria.action: return an empty packages list
criteria.contract: exit 0; result.packages is []

requirements.title: summary and next
requirements.rationale: An agent reading only summary and next must learn the answer and the one useful follow-up call that exists today.

criteria.condition: the report form succeeds
criteria.action: set summary to one sentence naming the package directory, its status, done tasks out of the total, the next task when there is one, and that the package does not validate when valid is false
criteria.contract: e.g. "speca: 16_indexed_code_search active, 3 of 7 tasks done; next task 4"; at most 200 characters

criteria.condition: the --validate form succeeds
criteria.action: set summary to one sentence saying whether the package validates and, when it does not, the error count and the rule names
criteria.contract: e.g. "speca: 16_indexed_code_search does not validate (3 errors: C3, C7, cross_spec_actor)"; at most 200 characters

criteria.condition: the --list form succeeds
criteria.action: set summary to one sentence with the number of packages, the non-zero counts per status in lifecycle order, and the number unreadable when non-zero
criteria.contract: e.g. "speca: 9 packages (2 draft, 5 active, 2 sealed)"; at most 200 characters

criteria.condition: the report form has a next_task N
criteria.action: suggest specr <spec_dir> --task N with a why saying whether the task is in progress or is the next ready task
criteria.contract: next contains exactly one entry with tool "specr"

criteria.condition: the --list form contains an active package with no task in progress and a ready task
criteria.action: suggest specr <spec_dir> --task N for the first such package in list order, where N is its next task
criteria.contract: next contains exactly one entry with tool "specr"

criteria.condition: the form is --validate, or the report has no next_task, or the list has no qualifying package
criteria.action: suggest no call
criteria.contract: next is absent or empty

requirements.title: Public output types and error envelopes
requirements.rationale: Callers decode every speca form with one standard-library-only type.

criteria.action: provide AdminResult as the single result type of every speca form, with valid as a pointer, the slices that must show as empty in their own form tagged omitzero, every field documented with a description tag, and every field a form does not produce absent from its JSON
provide AdminEnvelope = Envelope[*AdminResult] and DecodeSpeca(data []byte) (AdminEnvelope, error), which decodes the envelope of every speca form
criteria.contract: DecodeSpeca returns the decoded AdminEnvelope for any speca output, and a non-nil error for input that is not a JSON envelope

criteria.action: provide TaskCounts and PackageInfo, and add ready to TaskInfo, true for a pending task whose dependencies are all done and absent otherwise
import only the standard library and keep every existing exported name and JSON field with its meaning
define Result embedding envelope.AdminResult with Summary() and Next() methods, and set retryable and resumable to false on every envelope it writes

criteria.condition: the --schema document cannot be encoded
criteria.action: fail the call with an error envelope
criteria.contract: exit 1; error.stage "schema", error.category "internal"

execution_paths.title: An agent reads a package's state and follows the suggested next call

steps.action: runs speca 09 from the repository root
resolves the reference through internal/specpkg to .specs/09_agent_mode and loads it with afspec.LoadSpec
computes valid with Validate, tasks with ready via IsReady, next_task via NextTask, allowed_status via ValidTransition, and dependents via DiscoverSpecs and BuildDependencyGraph
writes one AdminEnvelope to stdout with summary and a next entry specr <spec_dir> --task N, and exits 0
runs specr <spec_dir> --task N and receives a RenderResult whose task carries ready

execution_paths.title: An agent asks for the full verdict on a package

steps.action: loads the target package and every loadable package under the spec root, builds a dependency graph and runs Validate and ValidateCrossSpec
keeps the cross-spec findings attributed to the package and converts them through internal/specpkg into validation and traceability
writes one envelope with valid, validation, traceability and a summary naming the failing rules, and exits 0

execution_paths.title: An agent lists every package including the archive

steps.action: lists NN_name directories under the spec root and under archive/, sorted numerically, and loads each with LoadSpec
builds one PackageInfo per directory, with load_error for packages that fail to load and archived: true for those under archive/
writes one envelope with packages, a per-status summary and the first claimable task as next, and exits 0

execution_paths.title: A malformed invocation is refused before anything is read

steps.action: parses the flags with cli.SplitArgs and detects a positional input together with --list
prints the message to stderr, writes one usage envelope with stage usage and category usage to stdout, and exits 2
